sermon.title: King David and King Jesus— August 2, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer compares King David with King Jesus. David sinned but repented; Jesus died for all sin. Both were betrayed by close friends and opposed by leaders, yet God’s plan prevailed. God stopped David’s plague when he repented and can stop any pandemic. He closes with the prayer to restore the joy of salvation.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What did God promise David in 2 Samuel 7:12?
